def factor_vwap_sma_range_std_regime(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([(df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]),
                    (df_copy["high"] - prev_close).abs(),
                    (df_copy["low"] - prev_close).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    norm_tr = tr / df_copy["close"]
    std_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20).std(ddof=1)
    compression = 1.0 / (1.0 + std_tr)
    vwap = (df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]).rolling(20).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20).sum()
    sma = df_copy["close"].rolling(20).mean()
    div = (vwap - sma) / df_copy["close"]
    factor = div * compression
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_range_std_regime"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_range_std_regime"]
description: Mutation of parent alpha-range-vol-gen0-001. Preserves the core price-volume coherence mechanism: VWAP-SMA divergence weighted by a range-based volatility compression. The parent used coefficient of variation of normalized true range (std/mean) as the compression weight. This mutation ablates the mean normalization in the compression term and uses the rolling standard deviation of normalized true range directly. This avoids dividing by a small noisy rolling mean, which should reduce compression estimate variance and improve ICIR while retaining the RankIC and RankICIR strengths of the parent.
